name: Echoes in the Deep - A Fateforge Tale
detailed_description:
Echoes in the Deep is a beautifully hand-drawn narrative-driven RPG set in the rich world of Fateforge as an accompaniment to the TTRPG. As Peridot Haps, a seasoned rogue with a storied past, you're planning one final heist.  But in a city built on secrets and shifting allegiances, success isn’t just about skill. It’s about who you trust, who you betray, and how you play the game.

With a branching narrative, deep character interactions, and dice-based gameplay powered by an augmented 5E ruleset, your choices will define your journey. Will you outplay fate or be consumed by it?

Explore the Free City

A sprawling, unpredictable world awaits. From the bustling streets above to the shadowed corridors of the Netherworld below, you’ll navigate eight distinct locations, each hiding new characters, choices, and challenges. Every step you take unlocks fresh story paths, but be careful where you tread.

Every Choice Has Consequences

In Echoes in the Deep, your crew’s loyalty is everything. Every action you take, every deception, every alliance, every sacrifice, will shape their perception of you. They may admire you, resent you, or even turn against you. And when the dice hit the table, their feelings could decide your fate.

Dice, Destiny, and the Power of Choice

Every action you take is determined by the roll of the dice, but the odds aren’t set in stone. Your crew’s loyalty, the gear you equip, and the choices you make all shape your chances of success. 

Welcome to Fateforge

Set in the sprawling, lawless Free City, Echoes in the Deep is part of the Fateforge Universe, a world of intrigue, danger, and untold mysteries. Built upon an augmented 5E ruleset, this game delivers a self-contained RPG experience where story and strategy collide. How will your story unfold?
